derivation:
by
  classical
  simpa only [pairSel, subRestrict, Finset.union_empty] using (Equiv.piFinsetUnion (fun _ : GObs Γ t => Bool) hXY).symm.bijective
explanation: Specialize the dependent function equivalence for disjoint finset unions to the constant family Bool. Its inverse is definitionally the pair of restriction maps, after removing the union with ∅.
